primary_calibration: narrow spheres with complete hydraulic predictors
sensitivity_calibration: narrow spheres and gravel with complete hydraulic predictors
calibration_loss: mean squared dimensionless flux error, material-balanced for pooled fit
evaluation_loss: mean absolute dimensionless flux error, material-balanced
normalization: largest dimensionless flux in primary narrow-sphere calibration
reference_measure: equal weight per grain cohort, then per run; neither log-orthopolic nor linear-orthopolic size allocation
